observed_problem: The SP001 Pilot registry currently defines only lineage, distribution, reasoning and coding scope dimensions, which is narrower than the authoritative TS-001 backlog. Material planned concerns such as model-family/ecosystem breadth, open-weight/license/reuse boundaries, inference/serving efficiency, long-context and cloud/developer ecosystem coverage can therefore fall outside the Pilot's initial completeness obligations.
expected_behavior: SP001 launch configuration must faithfully encode the scoped TS-001 research backlog while keeping China-specific/topic-specific semantics in edition configuration rather than generic Thematic Core code.
actual_behavior: config/survey-production-v2-pilots.json permits SP001 completeness to be argued against four dimensions that do not represent the full TS-001 planning scope recorded in docs/thematic-special-backlog.md.
production_workaround: Do not initialize SP001. WU-012F must align the Pilot registry/spec with TS-001 before external production begins.
improvement_action: Implement WU-012F: expand SP001 registry dimensions/initial obligations to match TS-001 planning authority, preserving generic Thematic Profile mechanisms and avoiding topic-specific Core branches.
